name: Mento Euro
who_can_redeem: Users can exchange supported assets for EURm and exchange EURm through Mento protocol pools and supported interfaces.
redemption_region_notes: Access depends on supported Mento routes, pool state, reserve state, oracle prices, fees, networks, and applicable restrictions.
redemption_notes: The asset launched as Celo Euro and was renamed Mento Euro on 17 December 2025 without a new contract, peg change, or required holder action.
summary: Euro-tracking Mento stablecoin launched on Celo as cEUR in April 2021 and renamed EURm in December 2025 without changing its contract identity; current Mento V3 documentation describes EURm as Reserve-backed.
notes: Growth D Batch T. Current reserve allocation, full contract history, multichain inventory, and exact V3 milestones remain open items.

name: Web 3 Dollar
who_can_redeem: Users may mint and redeem USD3 onchain through Reserve Protocol against its governed collateral basket.
redemption_region_notes: Access depends on Ethereum, supported interfaces, collateral availability, governance state, fees, liquidity, and applicable restrictions.
redemption_notes: USD3 targets one U.S. dollar through a governed basket of yield-bearing collateral and RSR overcollateralization. Holder returns are reflected through NAV appreciation rather than balance rebase.
summary: Ethereum-based Reserve Protocol RToken introduced in April 2024 as a fully asset-backed, overcollateralized, yield-bearing dollar asset governed by RSR stakers and supported by an evolving collateral basket.
notes: Growth D Batch T. Launch transaction boundary, contract-component inventory, governance map, historical basket changes, and current liquidity remain open items.
